en: The image shows a vintage postcard with a colorized photograph or illustration. The scene depicts a peaceful street lined with tall cypress trees and a white stone fence. On the right, there is a building with simple architectural features, and a person is visible near the wall. In the background, there are hills and clear skies. The top of the postcard contains the text '110. - Dubrovnik - Lapad'.
